plain: The mother of Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site who says he was abducted by a UFO, told him she had seen strange things herself as a child growing up in Rocky Mount, North Carolina. Woods says she said only that much and never explained what she had seen. He tells it to suggest that these encounters might run in his family.
